subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-10-01
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 1, 2026

No code shipped this session — and that's the right call. Spent the session closing out the one static audit (sxo.md) that hadn't been re-checked against current code yet, rather than forcing a page into an exhausted content backlog. Full detail below.

Ranking & backlinks

Fresh live pull (site_id 12704162, 2026-09-24→10-01, daily): average position flat at 100 (not-ranked floor) every day, all 22 tracked keywords still unranked. Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10. GitHub Actions: 45/45 SEO Report Email runs green, all-time.

Correction

An earlier report today listed "ship the claude mcp server pillar page" as a next step. Checked directly — that page has been live since 2026-08-06 (/blog/how-to-set-up-a-claude-mcp-server). It was a stale restatement, not a real gap. Won't resurface it again.

sxo.md closed out

Went through every item in the July SXO audit's priority list against the actual current code (not the audit's July prose). Seven of eight are already shipped: the misleading /services//work hub copy is gone (those routes don't exist any more), supermetrics-vs-arlo is live, the integration how-to cluster is live (5 connector pages + a Claude-MCP-server guide), the meta-ads-specialist page no longer 404s, FAQ schema is on every FAQ block, the top destination pages (Looker Studio, Power BI, BigQuery, Tableau, Google Sheets) all have comparison sections backed by real keyword demand, and every destination page now carries a dateModified signal. The one item still open is a second, independent case study — that needs a real client quote, so it stays a human task.

One new idea, checked and ruled out

The audit also suggested a comparison page against a competitor called 1ClickReport. Before building anything, pulled live keyword data for it and every variant (alternative, review, vs-arlo) — zero measurable search volume across the board. Not worth a page with no demand behind it, so it's shelved rather than built.

Still open, still needs a human

Same list as every recent report: Google Search Console sitemap submission, the 6 free off-page directory listings (0 shipped), the AI Result Tracker (no LLM engines configured — note: a tool to configure this exists in this session's toolset, but spending on the SE Ranking subscription isn't a call this routine makes on its own, so it's flagged here instead of actioned), and the second case study above.

Next

Every static audit (technical, on-page/schema, SXO) is now re-verified against current code and closed out. Nothing left to re-read cold — future sessions should keep re-pulling SE Ranking fresh and watch for any catalog.ts connector flipping from "coming soon" to live, which is the next real content opportunity.
